name: ShowOrganizer
description: A Jellyfin metadata provider plugin that allows users to specify an exact TMDB Episode Group ID for a TV series. It supports custom season and episode ordering while keeping custom season/episode numbering intact inside your Jellyfin library.
overview: Override built-in metadata providers to organize and map TV shows using exact TMDB episode group orderings.

versions.changelog: Add thread-safe async TMDb client configuration initialization (EnsureClientConfigAsync) to fix InvalidOperationException in profile/image URL resolution, deduplicate activation logging, and fix group name quote formatting.
Fix TMDb credential fallback to mirror Jellyfin's resolution chain (including TmdbUtils.ApiKey) and deduplicate missing client warning logs.
Reuse Jellyfin TMDb credentials by default, exact Episode Group mapping fix, diagnostic logging improvements, and custom branding logo.
Initial MVP release with TMDB episode group mapping and season name mapping.
